expected_level_description: You can: - advocate for agile working at the organisational level and with senior stakeholders - help organisations adopt agile research practices - set standards and expectations of how research insights should be delivered to support delivery by agile teams - coach and guide other user researchers to adopt agile ways of working
You can: - help an organisation to adopt a wide range of analysis and synthesis techniques, and to continually assure, improve and innovate their practices to generate clear and valuable findings

You can: - help organisations understand the diversity of users of government services - guide organisations to adopt inclusive practices and apply what they learn to design and deliver accessible services that work for all users

You can: - establish and align user research programmes and teams to meet organisational goals - synthesise findings from research programmes, producing strategic insights to inform the organisation’s roadmap - set and assure good practice user research standards for the organisation, including ethics and safeguarding - assure user research quality across the organisation

You can: - direct the stakeholder relationship strategy for your teams - ensure stakeholder's objectives are set and support teams to meet them - influence and negotiate with senior stakeholders to resolve issues and enable progress
You can: - help an organisation adopt a wide range of user research methods - lead a community of practice to help an organisation continually assure, improve and innovate their user research

You can: - find ways to help an organisation adopt user-centred practices and appreciate the value of understanding users - ensure discussions at senior levels or between organisations consider user needs and evolving user behaviour - help an organisation understand the complete journey of the user and use this knowledge to improve their services

You can: - shape organisational strategy using a deep understanding of the health and care system - represent the organisation with health and care partners and leaders - anticipate how policy and service changes will affect digital services and care

skill: Ethical research with patients and care staff
expected_level_description: You can: - set the organisation's standards for ethical research with patients, carers, and care staff - assure research practice across teams and advise on high-risk research - represent research practice to ethics, safeguarding, and governance bodies

You can: - lead data protection impact assessments and information sharing agreements - advise teams on lawful basis, consent, confidentiality, and retention - investigate incidents and recommend improvements
You can: - set inclusion strategy and hold the organisation to account for it - lead culture change on equality, diversity, and inclusion
You can: - take part in hazard workshops and contribute to a hazard log - follow the clinical risk management process for your work - provide evidence for a clinical safety case, such as test results
You can: - lead managers and shape the culture of a large area - design workforce plans and organisational change - coach leaders and resolve complex people issues
You can: - track spending against a small budget and raise variances - authorise spending within your limit
